task:
FIX THREE CODEX REVIEW FINDINGS ON PR #820 (purge P2b2a), review round 4. Branch codex/run-38794854189-1 at bcdfdae7c1d44713a5b5d9bd167e36f63f971cca. Change nothing else; do not weaken tests; do not change migration 016.

C1 (P1, blocks every delete in the normal topology): running_services in scripts/operator/lib/v3_purge_delete.py runs docker inspect on both authority-listed API slot names, but the governed deployer removes the prior slot with docker compose rm (scripts/operator/v3_production_deploy.py ~2355-2361) and bootstrap may never create it, so docker inspect fails and every delete-* stops. Treat a container that does not exist (docker's 'No such object' / exact not-found exit, distinguished from other failures) as not running. Still fail closed on any other inspect failure, malformed output, an unexpected container name, or a running container outside the authority list. Tests: one slot present + one absent passes; inspect failure for another reason fails closed.

C2 (receipt evidence): the delete/abort path stores WAL_SQL's result with bytes null in wal_before instead of measuring the pg_wal directory as the plan/authorize path does. Reuse that same measurement so wal_before (and wal_after) carry the physical pg_wal size; fail closed if it cannot be measured. Test that delete and abort receipts carry non-null wal bytes.

C3 (P1, autovacuum-fence deadline): age_gate admits a resumed delete when the projected time to the nearer XID/MultiXact ceiling covers only this dispatch plus 65 s. Design 4.2 (autovacuum paragraph) requires the open fence's deadline to cover the relation's remaining delete dispatches AND its rewrite at the planned cadence. Require the projected time to the nearer ceiling (at the measured XID and MultiXact rates) to be at least the reviewed remaining horizon: estimated remaining delete time (remaining target rows / the plan's measured or configured rows-per-second, with a conservative fallback recorded in the plan) plus the reviewed rewrite allowance for that relation (a plan field; if absent, refuse with autovacuum_fence_horizon_not_reviewed rather than invent one). When the horizon does not fit, refuse the delete and report next mode rewrite-<relation> if the relation is already logically empty, else abort-relation-<relation>. Same check before adopting an existing fence. Tests: near-ceiling resume is refused even when this dispatch alone would fit; comfortable margin passes; missing horizon fields refuse.

Run: ruff check .; bash -n scripts/operator/actions/v3-derived-generation-purge.sh; python -m pytest -q tests/test_v3_purge_delete_dispatch.py tests/test_v3_purge_delete_operator.py tests/test_v3_purge_delete_transactions.py tests/test_v3_derived_generation_purge_operator.py tests/test_v3_purge_transactions.py tests/test_v3_governed_derived_purge.py; python scripts/operator/v3_production_deploy.py --operation authority-gate; the Semgrep command from .github/workflows/semgrep.yml. Allowed files: those already changed by this PR. End with files changed and tests run with counts.
